title: Taxes declared state funds; penalties for failure to remit taxes; due and delinquent dates; judicial review

rows.trigger: theft of state funds by failing to remit collected taxes with intent to defraud; first conviction; NO lower dollar bound, any amount under $1,000
rows.quote: If the total amount of stolen revenue is less than $1,000, the offense is a misdemeanor of the second degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082 or s. 775.083.

rows.trigger: second conviction, same under-$1,000 tier; NO lower dollar bound
rows.quote: Upon a second conviction, the offender commits a misdemeanor of the first degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082 or s. 775.083.

rows.trigger: third or subsequent conviction, same under-$1,000 tier; NO lower dollar bound
rows.quote: Upon a third or subsequent conviction, the offender commits a felony of the third degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084.

rows.trigger: theft of state funds by failing to remit collected taxes with intent to defraud
rows.quote: If the total amount of stolen revenue is $1,000 or more, but less than $20,000, the offense is a felony of the third degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084.

rows.trigger: theft of state funds by failing to remit collected taxes with intent to defraud
rows.quote: If the total amount of stolen revenue is $20,000 or more, but less than $100,000, the offense is a felony of the second degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084.

rows.trigger: theft of state funds by failing to remit collected taxes with intent to defraud; statute states no upper bound; flush sentence after (d): amounts may be aggregated in determining the grade of the offense
rows.quote: If the total amount of stolen revenue is $100,000 or more, the offense is a felony of the first degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084.
